title: Inertial Thinking
english_paragraphs: A hotel is doing well and the owner is ready to start another business. Since he doesn't have much energy to manage the hotel, he plans to elect a general manager among the three department managers.

The boss asked the first department manager: "Which came first, the chicken or the egg?" The first department manager immediately replied: "What came first, the chicken." The boss then asked the second department manager the same question, and the second department manager answered affirmatively: "What came first, the egg." Finally, the boss asked the third department manager the same question. One department manager asked: "Which came first, do you think, the chicken or the egg?" The third department manager replied seriously: "If the customer orders the chicken first, the chicken comes first; if the customer orders the egg first, the egg comes first." The boss laughed, and he decided to choose the third department manager to be the general manager of the hotel.
When we change our perspective and break out of the limitations of inertial thinking, we embark on a new path.

A hotel is doing well and the owner is ready to start another business. Since he doesn't have much energy to manage the hotel, he plans to elect a general manager among the three department managers.

The boss asked the first department manager: "Which came first, the chicken or the egg?" The first department manager immediately replied: "What came first, the chicken." The boss then asked the second department manager the same question, and the second department manager answered affirmatively: "What came first, the egg." Finally, the boss asked the third department manager the same question. One department manager asked: "Which came first, do you think, the chicken or the egg?" The third department manager replied seriously: "If the customer orders the chicken first, the chicken comes first; if the customer orders the egg first, the egg comes first." The boss laughed, and he decided to choose the third department manager to be the general manager of the hotel.

When we change our perspective and break out of the limitations of inertial thinking, we embark on a new path.
russian_paragraphs: О́тель хоро́шо́ работает, и владелец гото́в нача́ть ещё одно́ де́ло. Поскольку у него́ не так уж и много эне́ргии, чтобы управля́ть о́телем, он плани́рует избрать генера́льного дире́ктора из трёх дире́кторов отде́лов.

Шеф спра́шивает пе́рвого дире́ктора: "Что появи́лось пе́рвым, цыплё́нок или яйцо́?" Пе́рвый дире́ктор неме́дленно отве́чает: "Пе́рвым появи́лся цыплё́нок." Затем шеф задаёт второй дире́ктор тот же вопро́с, и второй дире́ктор отве́чает утверди́тельно: "Пе́рвым появи́лось яйцо́." Наконец, шеф спра́шивает третий дире́ктор тот же вопро́с. Один из дире́кторов спра́шивает: "Что, по ва́шему меди́уму, появи́лось пе́рвым, цыплё́нок или яйцо́?" Третий дире́ктор серьёзно отве́чает: "Если зака́зчик заказывает цыплё́нка пе́рвым, то цыплё́нок появи́лся пе́рвым; если зака́зчик выбира́ет яйцо́ пе́рвым, то яйцо́ появи́лось пе́рвым." Шеф усмеха́ется и реша́ет вы́брать третьего дире́ктора как генера́льного дире́ктора о́теля.
Когда́ мы изменя́ем свою́ перспекти́ву и вырыва́емся из ограни́чений инерцио́нного мышле́ния, мы начина́ем но́вый путь.
reading_paragraphs: Ótel khorósho rabotáet, i vladélets gotóv nachát' eshchyo odnó délo. Poskól'ku u negó ne tak uź i mnogo énergii, chtoby upravlyát' ótel'em, on planíruiúet izbrat' generálnogo diréktora iz tryókh diréktorov otdélov.

Shef spráshiváet peŕvogo diréktora: "Chto poyavílos' peŕvym, tsyplyónok ili yaytsó?" Peŕvyy diréktor nemédlenno otvécháet: "Peŕvym poyavílsya tsyplyónok." Zatem shef zadáët vtoýnogo diréktora to zhe vopros, i vtoýnoy diréktor otvécháet utverdítel'no: "Peŕvym poyavílos' yaytsó." Nakónets, shef spráshiváet trétyego diréktora to zhe vopros. Odin iz diréktorov spráshiváet: "Chto, po váshemu mneniyu, poyavílos' peŕvym, tsyplyónok ili yaytsó?" Trétyy diréktor ser'yézno otvécháet: "Esli zakázchik zakazývaet tsyplyónka peŕvym, to tsyplyónok poyavílsya peŕvym; esli zakázchik vybiráet yaytsó peŕvym, to yaytsó poyavílos' peŕvym." Shef usmekháetsya i resháyet vyb́rat' trétyego diréktora kak generálnogo diréktora ótelya.
Kogdá my izmenjáem svóy perspektívy i vyrváíemsya iz ogranícheniy inercíonnogo myshléniya, my nachínáem nóvyy put'.
